--select * FROM EDS.CCD_CBCEXCTDBP

DECLARE @LATEST_DATE DATE;

SELECT  @LATEST_DATE = MAX(AS_OF_DATE) FROM EDS.CCD_CBCEXCTDBP;
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RN ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) TRAN_SK
,TXN_BANK_NBR
,TXN_PDT_NBR
,TXN_ACCT_NBR
,TXN_CARD_NBR
,TXN_BATCH_NBR
,TXN_DMS_CASE_NBR
,TXN_MECH_BANK_NBR
,TXN_MECH_NBR
FROM (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TXN_ACCT_NBR,TXN_CARD_NBR,TXN_CODE,TXN_POSTING_DTE,TXN_AUTH_CODE,TXN_BATCH_SEQ ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) RN
,TXN_BANK_NBR
,TXN_PDT_NBR
,TXN_ACCT_NBR
,TXN_CARD_NBR
,TXN_BATCH_NBR
,TXN_DMS_CASE_NBR
,TXN_MECH_BANK_NBR
,TXN_MECH_NBR
FROM EDS.CCD_CBCEXCTDBP
WHERE AS_OF_DATE = @LATEST_DATE

) A
